description: This PHP source file defines the 'Arn' class within the AWS SDK, which models Amazon Resource Names (ARNs). The class provides methods for parsing, validating, and representing ARNs as objects, along with methods to retrieve individual components and convert ARNs to string or array formats.

classes.name: Arn
classes.description: Represents and processes an AWS ARN (Amazon Resource Name), allowing parsing, validation, component extraction, and string conversion of ARN strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into its components: arn, partition, service, region, account_id, and resource.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an Arn object from a string or array, parsing and validating the ARN data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the Arn object back into its string representation.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the 'arn' prefix component of the ARN.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition component of the ARN.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service component of the ARN.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region component of the ARN.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource component of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the ARN data as an associative array.
